name: curb-sale
description: Sell or give away something you own to someone nearby, find secondhand things near you, and run the listing afterwards — messages, price, sold, gone. One unauthenticated HTTP call. No account, no API key, no signup.

interface.shortDescription: Local classifieds for physical things, in one unauthenticated HTTP call.
interface.longDescription: curb.sale is classifieds built to be used by software. Send a description, a photo, or both, and one unauthenticated POST returns a live public listing URL in seconds — no account, no API key, no signup, ever. Search the corpus geographically to find secondhand things near you, and message a seller through an accountless relay: the notification carries a relay address, so neither side learns the other's email address. Physical goods sold locally: two people meet. There is no payment, escrow, shipping or delivery. Listings expire in 30 days unless claimed, and coordinates are fuzzed to about 100 m, because a listing is someone's home.
defaultPrompt: Sell my old dresser on curb.sale — $80, I'm in Austin, TX.
Find me a used desk near Austin under $150.
Put this couch on the curb, free to whoever hauls it away.
